headlines.title: Global bond sell-off pushes U.S. Treasury yields to fresh 24-year highs
headlines.description: The yield on key U.S. Treasury bonds rose to fresh 24-year highs Wednesday, as the latest global bond sell-off picked up steam.

headlines.title: Sen. Ruben Gallego rolls out an economic agenda as he weighs a 2028 White House bid
headlines.description: The Arizona Democrat told NBC News he’s “absolutely thinking about” running for president. He’s pitching a New Deal-style jobs program funded by data center and AI taxes.

headlines.title: Fuel industry warns truck stops not to sell red dye diesel after Trump lifts restrictions
headlines.description: “We do not expect most reputable diesel retailers and fuel marketers to do this,” said several industry groups. “There’s limited upside.”

headlines.title: ‘A Skydance Corp.’: David Ellison immediately puts his stamp on Warner Bros.
headlines.description: The deal blends two historic film studios, two streaming platforms and two news organizations.

headlines.title: Carhartt CEO weighs in on retail affordability
headlines.description: The demand for skilled trade workers such as electricians, carpenters, and mechanics is expected to accelerate in the next decade and Carhartt, which has long been a staple for those doing these jobs, is seeing changes in the retail landscape. NBC News' Christine Romans spoke with Carhartt CEO Linda Hubbard about what the company is seeing as affordability remains top of mind for Americans.

headlines.title: Financial Tips to Support Your Kids and Your Aging Parents
headlines.description: The sandwich generation is that expensive time when you’re raising kids and helping out aging parents. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY with tips to navigate that financial situation and resources that can help.

headlines.title: Holiday Travel Planning: Smart Strategies as Prices Soar
headlines.description: With fuel prices sky-high, experts say Americans could face the highest costs in a decade. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with strategies to plan your holiday travel whether you’re flying or driving. She shares the cheapest days to fly, how to get relief at the pump, methods to compare costs, and more.

headlines.title: Paramount Skydance completes $110 billion ​takeover of Warner Bros.
headlines.description: Paramount Skydance completed its $110 billion ​takeover of Warner Bros., creating a Hollywood heavyweight called Skydance and handing CEO David ‌Ellison control. NBC News' Brian Cheung reports on the details of the merger.

headlines.title: For the same ticket on StubHub, different prices for different people
headlines.description: NBC News volunteers saw eight different prices for the exact same Harry Styles ticket on StubHub. The company said it’s running random price experiments.

headlines.title: S&P 500 closes at record high as Nvidia nears $6 trillion milestone
headlines.description: Gains by the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq were overwhelmingly powered by gains in tech companies.

headlines.title: Consumers sue Starbucks over ‘sugar-free’ drinks containing up to 21g of sugar
headlines.description: The company said it doesn’t add sugar to the drinks and that it uses sugar-free syrup for flavoring.

headlines.title: Political polarization is spiking in local communities ahead of the midterms, survey finds
headlines.description: Cost-of-living issues are driving up tensions in local communities, while immigration is the most polarizing issue nationally, local government officials said in a new survey.
